critical_sha_rule.requirement: After merge, read MAIN_POST_MERGE_SHA and deploy that exact checkout to Vercel production. Do not promote the pre-merge preview solely because its tree matches.

sequence: Create audited revert commit/PR against main.
Merge revert only after green checks.
Let GitHub Pages rebuild automatically from reverted main.
Deploy Vercel production again from the reverted main SHA.
application_source.emergency_vercel_traffic_mitigation: Vercel rollback can repoint production to a known-good prior production deployment, but it does not repair GitHub main or GitHub Pages and must not replace the audited source revert.
application_source.do_not_default_to_old_artifact: Current Vercel production is materially older (11.36.7). Before any emergency rollback, confirm compatibility with current database/runtime state. Prefer a freshly built reverted-main release when possible.
application_source.pwa_rule: Rollback smoke must verify service-worker STATIC_REVISION equals precache manifest revision and stale caches are replaced/claimed.
